1. **[blocking][issue-impact]** Dropping a rule rewrites unrelated valid TOML syntax instead of preserving it byte-exact. `sync_namespace_unique_rules` serializes `DocumentMut` whenever a drop occurs ([ruleset_store.rs:253](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/ruleset_store.rs:253)); its own comment acknowledges that serialization canonicalizes exotic-but-valid rule header spellings ([ruleset_store.rs:253](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/ruleset_store.rs:253)). Thus, dropping a default `namespace-unique-*` row can alter an unrelated custom `[[ rules ]]` or quoted-key header, violating REQ-01’s byte-exact preservation. Existing variant-header tests cover add-only syncs, not drops ([ruleset_store.rs:852](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/ruleset_store.rs:852)).

2. **[blocking][issue-impact]** Re-init can delete unrelated content when a membership drop leaves no `[[rules]]` entries. Re-init calls the sync and then `rewrite_rules_header` ([mod.rs:1139](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:1139)). With no remaining rule entry, that helper replaces the entire file with the generated header ([ruleset_store.rs:110](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/ruleset_store.rs:110)), discarding an unrelated trailing table or other content. The direct-sync test only checks preservation before this re-init-only rewrite step ([ruleset_store.rs:622](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/ruleset_store.rs:622)).
